# Security Policy

## Supported Versions

Security fixes are provided for the latest stable PLVS version. If you use an older version, update to the [latest stable version](https://github.com/SounDoer/PLVS/releases/latest). Reports about Preview builds are welcome.

## Reporting a Vulnerability

Use [GitHub's private vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/SounDoer/PLVS/security/advisories/new). Keep vulnerability details out of public issues, pull requests, and discussions while the report is being reviewed.

Include the affected PLVS version, operating system, steps to reproduce, and the potential impact. Omit credentials, personal data, and other sensitive information. The maintainer can follow up in the private report to coordinate a fix and disclosure.
